name: mori
description: Persistent, cross-device memory for your AI coding agents — self-hosted and AGPL, so your knowledge never leaves your own infrastructure. Connect to a Mori server you run; every session distils into durable, searchable memory, so agents start informed, not cold. /brief loads context, /pensieve searches it.

interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted shared memory that compounds across sessions
interface.longDescription:
Mori gives every coding agent session access to shared, durable memory — without changing how you work. Lifecycle hooks capture sessions automatically. The dream pipeline distils events into curated memories overnight. /brief re-grounds any agent on any machine from turn one.

Fully self-hosted (SQLite or Postgres). Your knowledge never leaves your own infrastructure. AGPL-3.0.
